findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No NuGet lock file is generated or committed for any project
findings.recommendation: Set <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile> in Directory.Build.props (or per-project) and commit the generated packages.lock.json files so restores are reproducible and tamper-evident, even though Directory.Packages.props already pins exact versions.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No SBOM or license inventory is present in the repository

evidence.excerpt:
<PackageVersion Include="Dapper" Version="2.1.79" />
... (35 PackageVersion entries, no accompanying SBOM/license manifest)

findings.recommendation: Generate a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM as part of CI (e.g. dotnet CycloneDX tool or dotnet list package --format json piped through a license-report tool) and publish it as a build artifact or commit it alongside the manifests.
